title: 第三章 寒鞘鸣野店逢异客第四章 尘缘误西凉起风波
content_zh:
残冬腊月，北风卷着鹅毛大雪，把雁门关外的官道刮得面目全非。天地间一片苍茫，雪粒子打在脸上，如细针穿刺，生疼刺骨。暮色四合之际，一座破败的野店孤零零地立在官道旁，土墙斑驳，屋顶的茅草被风吹得翻卷，像一头濒死巨兽的乱发，在风雪中苟延残喘。
野店的木门早已失去了漆色，布满了裂痕，推开来便发出“吱呀——吱呀——”的刺耳声响，仿佛要在这寂静的寒夜里断裂开来。店内昏黄的油灯摇曳不定，将墙面上映得忽明忽暗，勉强驱散了些许寒意与黑暗。墙角堆着几捆干枯的柴禾，散发着淡淡的烟火气，却终究暖不透这偌大的空荡。几张破旧的木桌歪歪扭扭地摆着，桌面布满了划痕与污渍，椅凳也大多残缺不全，唯有靠窗的一张桌子还算整齐，旁侧坐着一个身着青衫的男子。
青衫男子约莫三十出头年纪，容貌清癯，眉宇间带着一股淡淡的疏离与落寞，下颌处留着几缕短须，衬得面容愈发清俊。他身上的青衫已有些陈旧，边角甚至泛起了毛边，沾染了些许雪沫，却依旧干净整洁，不见半点邋遢。他端坐桌前，腰背挺直，手中握着一只粗瓷酒杯，杯中盛着半盏劣质的烧酒，却迟迟未曾饮下，只是目光沉沉地望着窗外漫天飞舞的大雪，仿佛在思索着什么，周身萦绕着一股生人勿近的清冷气息。
他腰间悬着一柄长剑，剑鞘是深黑色的，材质不明，没有任何纹饰，显得古朴而厚重，鞘身布满了细密的纹路，像是被岁月打磨过的痕迹，又像是被剑气侵蚀的印记。剑鞘触手生寒，即便是在这有灯火有柴禾的店内，也能感受到那股沁人心脾的凉意，仿佛这剑鞘本身，就藏着千年不化的冰雪。这柄剑，便是江湖上传说中极少有人见过的“寒鞘剑”，剑未出鞘，便已有隐隐的剑鸣之声，若遇强敌，寒鞘自鸣，剑气可透鞘而出，伤人于无形。
青衫男子名唤萧琰，江湖上人称“寒鞘客”。他无门无派，特立独行，行事亦正亦邪，不循常理，却极重信义，一诺千金。他的剑法出神入化，以快、准、狠著称，寒鞘剑出鞘之时，剑光如寒星破夜，凌厉非凡，江湖上能与他抗衡之人，寥寥无几。只是他性情孤僻，极少涉足江湖纷争，常年独来独往，行踪飘忽不定，有人说他隐居于深山之中，有人说他浪迹于天涯之外，唯有在每年残冬之际，才会偶尔出现在雁门关外的这片荒野之上。
萧琰已在这野店内坐了整整一个时辰。他来的时候，风雪刚刚起势，店内除了掌柜的，再无其他客人。掌柜的是个年近六旬的老者，头发花白，满脸皱纹，背有些驼，沉默寡言，只是守在灶台旁，添柴、温酒，偶尔抬头看一眼萧琰，眼中没有丝毫好奇，仿佛早已见惯了这样的江湖过客。
烧酒的辛辣气息在店内弥漫开来，混合着柴禾的烟火气，还有窗外风雪的寒气，构成了一种独特而苍凉的味道。萧琰轻轻转动着手中的粗瓷酒杯，目光依旧落在窗外，神色晦暗不明。他此次来雁门关，并非为了江湖恩怨，也并非为了寻人觅友，而是为了一枚玄铁令——一枚江湖上传说中能号令天下，有求必应的玄铁令。
玄铁令质地坚硬，通体漆黑，上面刻着一道模糊的纹路，无人知晓其具体来历，只知道玄铁令的主人，曾是江湖上一位惊才绝艳的高手，当年凭借一枚玄铁令，号令群雄，无人敢不从。后来，那位高手离奇失踪，玄铁令也随之下落不明，江湖上的各路豪杰，为了争夺这枚玄铁令，掀起了无数腥风血雨，死伤无数。有人说，玄铁令藏在雁门关外的某个隐秘之处，有人说，玄铁令早已落入了某个顶尖高手的手中，还有人说，玄铁令不过是一个传说，根本不存在于世间。
萧琰之所以要寻找玄铁令，是为了兑现一个承诺。三年前，他曾受一位故人所托，若是日后有机会，便寻找玄铁令，解开一个隐藏了数十年的江湖秘辛。那位故人临终之际，将一枚半块的玉佩交给了他，告诉他，玄铁令与这半块玉佩息息相关，唯有找到玄铁令，才能拼凑出完整的玉佩，揭开那个秘辛的真相。这三年来，萧琰踏遍了大江南北，历经了无数艰险，终于查到，玄铁令或许就在雁门关外，而这野店，便是寻找玄铁令的关键之地。
“吱呀——”
又是一声刺耳的木门开合声，打破了店内的寂静。风雪裹挟着一个身影，猛地闯了进来，带起一阵刺骨的寒风，吹得油灯的火苗剧烈摇曳了几下，险些熄灭。萧琰缓缓收回目光，抬眼望去，目光平静无波，没有丝毫波澜，仿佛早已预料到会有客人前来。
进来的是一个身着黑衣的男子，身形高大挺拔，肩宽腰窄，周身散发着一股凛冽的寒气，比窗外的风雪还要刺骨。他头戴一顶黑色的斗笠，斗笠的帽檐压得很低，遮住了他的大半张脸，只露出线条紧绷的下颌和一截苍白的脖颈，看不清容貌与神情。他身上的黑衣料子极佳，质地柔软，却异常厚实，即便沾染了厚厚的雪沫，也依旧平整顺滑，不见半点褶皱，与这破败的野店格格不入。
黑衣男子周身萦绕着一股淡淡的血腥味，混杂着风雪的寒气，若有若无地散发出来，虽不浓烈，却足以让人察觉到他绝非善类。他的双手藏在衣袖之中，步伐沉稳而迅捷，每一步踏在冰冷的泥地上，都没有发出丝毫声响，显然是身怀绝技之人。他没有看店内的掌柜，也没有看萧琰，径直走到了萧琰对面的那张桌子旁，缓缓坐下，动作从容不迫，仿佛这野店只是他常来的地方。
“掌柜的，温一壶烧酒，再来一碟酱牛肉，一碟花生米。”黑衣男子的声音低沉沙哑，像是被砂纸打磨过一般，带着一股说不出的冰冷与压抑，没有丝毫情绪波动，听不出喜怒哀乐。他的声音不大，却清晰地传遍了整个店内，压过了油灯燃烧的噼啪声和窗外风雪的呼啸声。
掌柜的抬了抬头，看了黑衣男子一眼，眼中依旧没有丝毫好奇，只是轻轻点了点头，低声应道：“好嘞，客官稍等。”说完，便转身走向灶台，继续添柴温酒，动作依旧缓慢而沉稳，仿佛眼前的这一切，都与他无关。
黑衣男子坐下之后，便缓缓抬起头，斗笠的帽檐微微倾斜，露出了一双狭长的眼睛。那双眼眸漆黑如墨，深邃不见底，没有丝毫光亮，像是一潭死水，却又暗藏着凌厉的锋芒，仿佛能看穿人心，让人不寒而栗。他的目光缓缓扫过店内，最终落在了萧琰的身上，停留了片刻，神色依旧晦暗不明，看不出他心中的想法。
萧琰迎上他的目光，神色平静，没有丝毫避让，也没有丝毫敌意，只是淡淡地看了他一眼，便又缓缓低下头，目光重新落在了手中的粗瓷酒杯上，仿佛眼前的黑衣男子，只是一个普通的江湖过客，不值一提。但只有萧琰自己知道，眼前这个黑衣男子，绝非寻常之人，他周身的气息，凌厉而诡异，武功必定极高，甚至有可能，比自己还要厉害几分。
更让萧琰在意的是，他能感受到，黑衣男子的身上，也有一股与玄铁令相似的气息，虽然微弱，却异常清晰。而且，他注意到，黑衣男子的腰间，也悬着一件东西，被黑衣的衣襟遮住了大半，只能看到一小截黑色的鞘身，与自己的寒鞘剑有些相似，却又更加诡异，隐隐有一股邪气散发出来。
寒鞘剑似乎察觉到了什么，鞘身微微震动了一下，发出了一声极其细微的剑鸣之声，“嗡——”的一声，清脆而凌厉，却又很快消散在空气中，若不仔细聆听，根本无法察觉。这声剑鸣，只有萧琰和黑衣男子听到了。
萧琰的指尖微微一顿，心中微微一动。他的寒鞘剑，向来沉稳，若非遇到极强的对手，或是感受到了极大的威胁，绝不会轻易鸣响。而眼前这个黑衣男子，竟然能让寒鞘剑主动鸣响，可见其武功之高，气场之强，绝非自己所能小觑。

黑衣男子听到寒鞘剑的鸣响之声，狭长的眼眸微微一缩，眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的讶异，随即又恢复了平静。他的嘴角，似乎微微向上勾起了一抹极淡的弧度，快得让人无法捕捉，像是嘲讽，又像是玩味。他缓缓抬起手，伸出一根手指，轻轻敲击着桌面，“笃、笃、笃——”，节奏缓慢而均匀，却带着一股无形的压力，弥漫在整个店内。
店内的气氛，瞬间变得紧张起来，仿佛空气中都弥漫着无形的硝烟，一触即发。掌柜的依旧守在灶台旁，低头添柴，仿佛没有察觉到店内的异样，只是他的双手，微微有些颤抖，显然，他也感受到了这股诡异而凌厉的气场。
片刻之后，掌柜的端着一斛温好的烧酒，还有一碟酱牛肉、一碟花生米，缓缓走了过来，轻轻放在黑衣男子的桌上，低声说道：“客官，您要的东西来了。”说完，便转身匆匆离开了，不敢多停留片刻，仿佛多待一秒，都会有生命危险。
黑衣男子没有看掌柜的，也没有动桌上的烧酒和菜肴，只是依旧用那双漆黑深邃的眼睛，盯着萧琰，缓缓开口，声音依旧低沉沙哑，带着一股冰冷的寒意：“寒鞘剑，寒鞘客，萧琰？”
萧琰缓缓抬起头，迎上他的目光，神色依旧平静，淡淡的说道：“正是在下。不知阁下高姓大名，为何会认识在下？”他的声音不高，却清晰而沉稳，没有丝毫畏惧，即便面对眼前这个神秘而强大的黑衣男子，也依旧从容不迫。
黑衣男子闻言，嘴角又勾起了一抹极淡的弧度，那弧度中，带着一丝嘲讽，又带着一丝诡异：“在下无名无姓，江湖上的人，都称在下为‘鬼客’。至于为何会认识你，沈公子，你觉得，在这雁门关外，除了你，还有谁会带着寒鞘剑，在这大雪纷飞的寒夜，守在这破败的野店里？”
鬼客？
萧琰的心中微微一沉。他虽常年独来独往，极少涉足江湖纷争，却也听过鬼客的名声。鬼客，是江湖上近两年来崛起的一位神秘高手，性情残暴，出手狠辣，从不留情，所到之处，必定血流成河，尸横遍野。他无门无派，行踪飘忽不定，没有人知道他的来历，也没有人见过他的真面目，只知道他武功极高，诡异莫测，江湖上许多顶尖高手，都败在了他的手中，甚至有人说，他的武功，已经达到了出神入化的境界，无人能敌。
萧琰万万没有想到，自己竟然会在这破败的野店里，遇到传说中的鬼客。而且，看鬼客的样子，显然是早就知道自己在这里，特意来找自己的。
“阁下找在下，想必不是只为了认认在下的模样吧？”萧琰淡淡的说道，手中依旧握着那只粗瓷酒杯，指尖轻轻摩挲着杯壁，神色平静，看不出心中的想法，“若是阁下有什么事，不妨直言相告。”
鬼客闻言，缓缓抬起手，摘下了头上的斗笠。瞬间，一张狰狞可怖的脸庞，出现在了萧琰的眼前。那张脸上，布满了狰狞的疤痕，纵横交错，像是被刀砍剑划一般，右眼处有一道长长的疤痕，从额头一直延伸到下颌，遮住了他的右眼，只剩下一只左眼，漆黑深邃，暗藏着凌厉的锋芒与诡异的光芒，让人不寒而栗。他的鼻子有些歪斜，嘴唇也有些干裂，整张脸看起来，异常狰狞，让人望而生畏。
萧琰看到鬼客的脸庞，神色依旧没有丝毫变化，既没有惊讶，也没有畏惧，只是淡淡地看了一眼，便又缓缓低下头，仿佛眼前这张狰狞可怖的脸庞，只是一张普通的面孔。
鬼客似乎早已习惯了别人看到自己脸庞时的惊讶与畏惧，看到萧琰的反应，眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的诧异，随即又恢复了平静。他缓缓端起桌上的烧酒，倒了一杯，杯中酒液清澈，泛着淡淡的酒香，却依旧驱散不了他周身的寒气。
content_en:
In the twelfth lunar month of winter, the north wind carried heavy snow, and the official road outside Yanmen Pass was changed beyond recognition. There was a vast expanse between the sky and the earth, and the snow particles hitting my face were like tiny needles pricking me, causing pain and bone-piercing pain. At dusk, a dilapidated wild shop stood alone beside the official road. The earthen walls were mottled, and the thatch on the roof was blown by the wind, like the messy hair of a dying beast, lingering in the wind and snow.
The wooden door of the wild store has long lost its paint color and is full of cracks. When it is pushed open, it makes a harsh sound of "squeaking-squeaking-", as if it is about to break in this silent cold night. The dim yellow oil lamp in the store flickered, flickering the walls, barely dispelling some of the chill and darkness. There were several bundles of dry firewood piled in the corner, emitting a faint smoke of smoke, but it could not warm the vast emptiness after all. Several old wooden tables were placed crookedly. The tabletops were covered with scratches and stains, and most of the chairs and stools were incomplete. Only the table by the window was relatively neat, and a man in a blue shirt sat next to it.
The man in a green shirt is about in his early thirties, with a pale face, a touch of alienation and loneliness between his eyebrows, and a few short strands of beard on his chin, which makes his face even more handsome. The green shirt on his body was a little old, and the corners even had rough edges and were stained with a little snow foam, but it was still clean and tidy, not a bit sloppy. He sat at the table with his back straight, holding a coarse porcelain wine glass in his hand. The glass contained half a cup of low-quality soju, but he had not yet drank it. He just stared out the window at the heavy snow flying in the sky, as if thinking about something, and there was a cold aura around him that kept strangers away.
There is a long sword hanging on his waist. The scabbard is dark black with unknown material and no decorations. It looks simple and heavy. The scabbard is covered with fine lines, which look like traces of being polished by the years or marks eroded by the sword energy. The scabbard is cold to the touch, and even in this shop with lights and firewood, you can still feel the refreshing coolness, as if the scabbard itself contains ice and snow that has not melted for thousands of years. This sword is the "cold scabbard sword" that few people have seen in legends in the world. Before the sword is taken out of the scabbard, there will be a faint sound of sword clanging. If it encounters a strong enemy, the cold scabbard will chirp, and the sword energy can come out through the scabbard, injuring people invisible.
The man in green shirt is named Xiao Yan, and is known as "Hanshuo Ke" in the world. He has no family and no sect, he is independent, he acts both rightly and wrongly, and does not follow common sense, but he attaches great importance to faith and promises a thousand pieces of gold. His swordsmanship is superb and he is famous for his speed, accuracy and ruthlessness. When the Cold Scabbard Sword is unsheathed, the light of the sword is like a cold star breaking through the night. It is extremely sharp. There are only a few people in the world who can compete with him. It's just that he has a withdrawn temperament and rarely gets involved in the disputes between rivers and lakes. He travels alone all year round and his whereabouts are erratic. Some say he lives in seclusion in the mountains, while others say he wanders around the world. He only occasionally appears in the wilderness outside Yanmen Pass every year at the end of winter.
Xiao Yan has been sitting in this restaurant for a whole hour. When he arrived, the wind and snow had just begun, and there were no other customers in the store except the shopkeeper. The shopkeeper is an old man in his sixties, with gray hair, a wrinkled face, and a hunched back. He is taciturn. He just stays by the stove, adding firewood and warming wine. He occasionally looks up at Xiao Yan. There is no curiosity in his eyes, as if he has been used to seeing such travelers.
The spicy aroma of soju permeates the store, mixed with the smoke of firewood and the cold air of the wind and snow outside the window, creating a unique and desolate taste. Xiao Yan gently turned the rough porcelain wine glass in his hand, his eyes still falling outside the window, his expression dark and unclear. He came to Yanmen Pass this time, not for grudges in the world, nor to find people and friends, but for a Black Iron Order - a Black Iron Order that was said to be able to command the world and respond to all requests.
The Black Iron Token is hard and completely black, with a vague pattern engraved on it. No one knows its specific origin, only the owner of the Black Iron Token is known.He was once an extremely talented master in the world of martial arts. Back then, he used a black iron order to command the heroes, and no one dared to disobey him. Later, the master mysteriously disappeared, and the whereabouts of the Black Iron Order were also unknown. Heroes from all walks of life in the world fought for the Black Iron Order, causing countless bloody storms and causing countless deaths and injuries. Some people say that the Black Iron Order is hidden in a secret place outside Yanmen Pass. Some say that the Black Iron Order has already fallen into the hands of a top master. Others say that the Black Iron Order is just a legend and does not exist in the world at all.
The reason why Xiao Yan is looking for Xuan Tie Ling is to fulfill a promise. Three years ago, he was entrusted by an old friend. If there was a chance in the future, he would look for the Black Iron Order and unlock a secret that had been hidden for decades. When the old friend was dying, he handed him a half-piece of jade pendant and told him that the Black Iron Order was closely related to this half of the jade pendant. Only by finding the Black Iron Order could the complete jade pendant be pieced together and the secret truth revealed. In the past three years, Xiao Yan traveled all over the country, experienced numerous hardships and dangers, and finally found out that the Xuan Tie Order might be outside Yanmen Pass, and this wild store was the key place to find the Xuan Tie Order.
"Squeak——"
Another harsh sound of the wooden door opening and closing broke the silence in the store. The wind and snow carried a figure and rushed in suddenly, bringing with it a biting cold wind, which caused the flame of the oil lamp to sway violently for a few times and almost went out. Xiao Yan slowly withdrew his gaze and looked up. His eyes were calm and unruffled, as if he had already expected that guests would come.
What came in was a man dressed in black. He was tall and straight, with broad shoulders and narrow waist. He was exuding a biting cold air, which was even more biting than the wind and snow outside the window. He wore a black hat with a low brim, covering most of his face. Only his tight jaw and a pale neck were exposed, and his appearance and expression could not be seen clearly. The black clothes on his body were made of excellent material, soft in texture, but extremely thick. Even if it was stained with thick snow foam, it was still smooth and smooth without any wrinkles, which was incompatible with this dilapidated wild store.
There was a faint smell of blood lingering around the man in black, mixed with the cold air of the wind and snow, and it was emitted vaguely. Although it was not strong, it was enough to make people realize that he was definitely not a kind person. His hands were hidden in his sleeves, and his steps were steady and swift. Every step he took on the cold mud made no sound. He was obviously a man with special skills. He didn't look at the shopkeeper or Xiao Yan. He walked straight to the table opposite Xiao Yan and sat down slowly, moving calmly and leisurely, as if this wild shop was just a place he frequented.
"Shopkeeper, warm up a pot of soju, and bring a plate of soy sauce beef, and a plate of peanuts." The man in black's voice was low and hoarse, as if it had been polished by sandpaper, with an indescribable coldness and depression, without any emotional fluctuations, and no joy, anger, sorrow, or joy could be heard. His voice was not loud, but it spread clearly throughout the entire store, overpowering the crackling of the burning oil lamp and the whistling of the wind and snow outside the window.
The shopkeeper raised his head and glanced at the man in black. There was still no curiosity in his eyes. He just nodded slightly and said in a low voice: "Okay, sir, please wait a moment." After saying that, he turned and walked to the stove and continued to add firewood and warm wine. His movements were still slow and steady, as if everything in front of him had nothing to do with him.
After the man in black sat down, he slowly raised his head. The brim of his hat tilted slightly, revealing a pair of narrow eyes. Those eyes were as dark as ink, bottomless, without any light, like a pool of stagnant water, but they concealed a sharp edge, as if they could see through people's hearts, making people shudder. His eyes slowly swept across the store and finally landed on Xiao Yan. He stayed for a moment, his expression still dark and unclear, and it was impossible to tell what he was thinking.
Xiao Yan met his gaze with a calm expression, without the slightest evasion or hostility.She glanced at him indifferently, then slowly lowered her head, and her eyes fell on the rough porcelain wine glass in her hand again, as if the man in black in front of her was just an ordinary passerby, not worth mentioning. But only Xiao Yan himself knew that the man in black in front of him was definitely not an ordinary person. The aura around him was sharp and strange, and his martial arts must be extremely high. He might even be a little better than himself.
What made Xiao Yan even more concerned was that he could feel that the man in black had an aura similar to that of Xuan Tieling. Although it was weak, it was extremely clear. Moreover, he noticed that there was something hanging on the waist of the man in black. It was mostly covered by the skirt of the black clothes. Only a small part of the black sheath could be seen. It was somewhat similar to his cold sheath sword, but it was even weirder. There was a faint evil aura emanating from it.
The cold sheath sword seemed to have noticed something. The sheath body vibrated slightly and made an extremely subtle sword cry. The sound of "buzz--" was crisp and sharp, but it quickly dissipated in the air. If you don't listen carefully, you can't detect it at all. Only Xiao Yan and the man in black heard the sound of the sword.
Xiao Yan's fingertips paused slightly, and his heart moved slightly. His cold sheath sword has always been calm. Unless he encounters a very strong opponent or feels a great threat, he will never sound it easily. And the man in black in front of him can actually make the cold sheath sword sound automatically, which shows that his martial arts skills and strong aura are beyond his ability to underestimate.
When the man in black heard the sound of the cold sheath sword, his narrow eyes narrowed slightly, a trace of imperceptible surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he regained his composure. The corners of his mouth seemed to curve slightly upward, too fast for anyone to catch, like a mockery or amusement. He slowly raised his hand, stretched out a finger, and tapped the table gently, "Tuk, Tuk, Tuk—" The rhythm was slow and even, but it carried an invisible pressure that permeated the entire store.
The atmosphere in the store suddenly became tense, as if the air was filled with invisible gunpowder smoke and was about to explode. The shopkeeper was still standing by the stove, lowering his head to add firewood. He seemed not to notice anything strange in the store, but his hands were trembling slightly. Apparently, he also felt this strange and sharp aura.
After a while, the shopkeeper came over slowly with a bottle of warm soju, a plate of soy sauce beef, and a plate of peanuts. He gently placed it on the table of the man in black and whispered: "Sir, what you asked for is here." After saying that, he turned around and left in a hurry, not daring to stay for a moment longer, as if staying for a second longer would be in danger of his life.
The man in black did not look at the shopkeeper, nor did he touch the soju and dishes on the table. He just stared at Xiao Yan with his dark eyes and spoke slowly, his voice still low and hoarse, with an icy chill: "Han Sheath Sword, Han Sheath Guest, Xiao Yan?"
Xiao Yan slowly raised her head, met his gaze, her expression was still calm, and she said calmly: "It's me. I wonder why you know me with your high surname?" His voice was not high, but it was clear and steady, without the slightest fear. Even when facing the mysterious and powerful man in black in front of him, he remained calm and calm.
When the man in black heard the words, the corners of his mouth curved again, with a hint of ridicule and a hint of weirdness: "I have no name, and people in the world call me 'Ghost Guest'. As for why I know you, Mr. Shen, do you think, outside Yanmen Pass, who else besides you would carry a cold sheath sword and guard this dilapidated wild inn on this snowy cold night?"
Ghost guest?
Xiao Yan's heart sank slightly. Although he lives alone all year round and rarely gets involved in disputes in the world, he has also heard of the reputation of ghost guest. Guike is a mysterious master who has risen in the world in the past two years. He has a cruel temperament, ruthless attacks, and no mercy. Wherever he goes, there will be blood.It flows into a river and corpses litter the fields. He has no family and no sect, and his whereabouts are erratic. No one knows his origins, and no one has seen his true face. They only know that his martial arts are extremely high and unpredictable. Many top masters in the world have been defeated by him. Some even say that his martial arts has reached a state of perfection that no one can beat.
Xiao Yan never expected that he would encounter the legendary ghost guest in this dilapidated wild shop. Moreover, judging from the appearance of the ghost guest, it was obvious that he had known that he was here for a long time and had come to see him specially.
"Your Excellency is looking for me, you must not just want to recognize my appearance, right?" Xiao Yan said lightly, still holding the rough porcelain wine glass in his hand, his fingertips gently rubbing the wall of the glass, his expression was calm, and it was impossible to tell what was in his heart, "If you have something to do, you might as well tell me directly."
Hearing this, Guike slowly raised his hand and took off the bamboo hat on his head. In an instant, a ferocious and terrifying face appeared in front of Xiao Yan. The face was covered with ferocious scars, criss-crossed, as if cut by a knife. There was a long scar on his right eye, extending from his forehead to his chin, covering his right eye. Only one left eye was left, which was dark and deep, hiding a sharp edge and a strange light, which made people shudder. His nose was a little crooked and his lips were a little chapped. His whole face looked extremely ferocious and intimidating.
When Xiao Yan saw Guike's face, his expression remained unchanged. He was neither surprised nor afraid. He just glanced at it lightly and then slowly lowered his head, as if the hideous and terrifying face in front of him was just an ordinary face.
Guike seemed to have long been accustomed to the surprise and fear of others when they saw his face. When he saw Xiao Yan's reaction, a trace of imperceptible surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he regained his composure. He slowly picked up the soju on the table and poured a glass. The liquid in the glass was clear and had a faint aroma of wine, but it still couldn't dispel the cold air around him.
